SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM( SELECT T_B.ORDER_CODE ,T_B.ORDER_AMT ,T_B.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL ,T_B.ORDER_AMT_0 ,T_B.REMITTANCE_AMT ,T_B.CNTR_USE_POINT ,T_B.MATCH_YN ,T_B.HOLD_CNT ,T_B.CREATED_DATE FROM( SELECT T_A.ORDER_CODE ORDER_CODE , MAX(T_A.ORDER_AMT) ORDER_AMT , MAX(T_A.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL) ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , MAX(T_A.ORDER_AMT_0) ORDER_AMT_0 , MAX(T_A.REMITTANCE_AMT) REMITTANCE_AMT , MAX(T_A.CNTR_USE_POINT) CNTR_USE_POINT , CASE WHEN SUM(T_A.ORDER_AMT - T_A.ORDER_AMT_0 - T_A.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL) = SUM(T_A.CNTR_USE_POINT) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END MATCH_YN , MAX(T_A.CREATED_DATE) CREATED_DATE , MAX(T_A.HOLD_CNT) HOLD_CNT FROM ( SELECT ORDER_CODE ORDER_CODE , SUM(CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT)) ORDER_AMT , SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('65', '75') THEN CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = '0' THEN CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 REMITTANCE_AMT , 0 CNTR_USE_POINT , MAX(CREATED_DATE) CREATED_DATE , SUM(HOLD_CNT) HOLD_CNT FROM ( SELECT ORDER_CODE, ORDER_STATUS, SALE_PRICE , QUANTITY , ETC_AMT , CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%'
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_CODE, ORDER_STATUS, SALE_PRICE , QUANTITY , ETC_AMT , CREATED_DATE , 1 HOLD_CNT FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM_HOLD H WHERE 1 = 1
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE 1=1 AND OI.ORDER_CODE = H.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = H.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.ITEM_SEQUENCE = H.ITEM_SEQUENCE ) ) OI WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY ORDER_CODE UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_CODE , 0 ORDER_AMT , 0 ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , SUM(CAST( RD.SALE_PRICE * RD.QUANTITY + RD.ETC_AMT AS BIGINT)) REMITTANCE_AMT , 0 CNTR_USE_POINT , NULL CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT FROM OP_REMITTANCE_DETAIL RD WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%'
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
GROUP BY ORDER_CODE UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_CODE , 0 ORDER_AMT , 0 ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , 0 REMITTANCE_AMT , SUM(CASE WHEN USE_SE_CODE = '1' THEN CAST( CNTR_USE_POINT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) CNTR_USE_POINT , NULL CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%'
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
GROUP BY ORDER_CODE ) T_A WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY ORDER_CODE
) T_B where 1=1
and T_B.match_yn = #{matchYnType}
and T_B.created_date BETWEEN NVL(#{searchStartDate}, CONCAT(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), '0101') || '000000') AND NVL(#{searchEndDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '235959') )

SELECT CASE WHEN T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN T_C.ORDER_CODE ELSE '합계' end ORDER_CODE , case when T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN MAX(T_C.ORDER_STATUS_DESC) end ORDER_STATUS_DESC , case when T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN max(T_C.locgov_nm) end locgov_nm , TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT), '999,999,999,999') ORDER_AMT , TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL), '999,999,999,999') ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT_0) , '999,999,999,999') ORDER_AMT_0 , TO_CHAR(SUM(CNTR_USE_POINT), '999,999,999,999') CNTR_USE_POINT , TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.REMITTANCE_AMT) , '999,999,999,999') REMITTANCE_AMT , CASE WHEN T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN MAX(T_C.CREATED_DATE) end CREATED_DATE , CASE WHEN T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN
CASE WHEN MAX(T_C.MATCH_YN) = 'Y' THEN '금액일치' ELSE '금액불일치' END ELSE TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT) - SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL) - SUM(T_C.ORDER_AMT_0) - SUM(T_C.CNTR_USE_POINT) , '999,999,999,999') END MATCH_YN , TO_CHAR(SUM(T_C.HOLD_CNT), '999,999,999,999') HOLD_CNT FROM ( SELECT T_B.ORDER_CODE ,T_B.ORDER_STATUS_DESC /* 주문상태 (추가됨) */ ,lgov.upper_locgov_nm || ' ' || lgov.locgov_nm locgov_nm ,T_B.ORDER_AMT ,T_B.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL ,T_B.ORDER_AMT_0 ,T_B.REMITTANCE_AMT ,T_B.CNTR_USE_POINT ,T_B.MATCH_YN ,T_B.HOLD_CNT ,T_B.CREATED_DATE FROM( SELECT T_A.ORDER_CODE ORDER_CODE , MAX(T_A.locgov_code) locgov_code , MAX(T_A.ORDER_STATUS_DESC) ORDER_STATUS_DESC , cast(sum(T_A.ORDER_AMT) as bigint) ORDER_AMT , cast(sum(T_A.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL) as bigint) ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , cast(sum(T_A.ORDER_AMT_0) as bigint) ORDER_AMT_0 , cast(sum(T_A.REMITTANCE_AMT) as bigint) REMITTANCE_AMT , cast(sum(T_A.CNTR_USE_POINT) as bigint) CNTR_USE_POINT , MAX(T_A.CREATED_DATE) CREATED_DATE
, case WHEN SUM(T_A.ORDER_AMT - T_A.ORDER_AMT_0 - T_A.ORDER_AMT_CANCEL) = SUM(T_A.CNTR_USE_POINT) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' end MATCH_YN , sum(T_A.HOLD_CNT) HOLD_CNT FROM ( SELECT ORDER_CODE ORDER_CODE , MAX(locgov_code) locgov_code , SUM(CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT)) ORDER_AMT , SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('65', '75') THEN CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = '0' THEN CAST( SALE_PRICE * QUANTITY + ETC_AMT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 REMITTANCE_AMT , 0 CNTR_USE_POINT , MAX(CREATED_DATE) CREATED_DATE , SUM(HOLD_CNT) HOLD_CNT , group_concat(CASE when ORDER_STATUS = '0' then '결제대기' when ORDER_STATUS = '10' then '결제완료' when ORDER_STATUS = '20' then '배송준비중' when ORDER_STATUS = '30' then '배송중' when ORDER_STATUS = '35' then '배송완료' when ORDER_STATUS = '40' then '구매확정' when ORDER_STATUS = '50' then '교환처리중' when ORDER_STATUS = '55' then '교환배송중' when ORDER_STATUS = '58' then '교환배송완료' when ORDER_STATUS = '59' then '교환거절' when ORDER_STATUS = '60' then '반품처리중' when ORDER_STATUS = '65' then '반품완료' when ORDER_STATUS = '69' then '반품거절' when ORDER_STATUS = '70' then '취소처리중' when ORDER_STATUS = '75' then '취소완료' end SEPARATOR '+') ORDER_STATUS_DESC FROM ( /* OP_ORDER_ITEM , OP_ORDER_ITEM_HOLD 조회 */ SELECT ORDER_CODE, ORDER_STATUS, SALE_PRICE , QUANTITY , ETC_AMT , CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT , locgov_code FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%' UNION ALL SELECT ORDER_CODE, ORDER_STATUS, SALE_PRICE , QUANTITY , ETC_AMT , CREATED_DATE , 1 HOLD_CNT , locgov_code FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM_HOLD H WHERE 1 = 1
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OP_ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE 1=1 AND OI.ORDER_CODE = H.ORDER_CODE AND OI.ORDER_SEQUENCE = H.ORDER_SEQUENCE AND OI.ITEM_SEQUENCE = H.ITEM_SEQUENCE ) ) OI WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY ORDER_CODE UNION ALL SELECT /* OP_REMITTANCE_DETAIL 조회 */ ORDER_CODE , NULL locgov_code , 0 ORDER_AMT , 0 ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , SUM(CAST( RD.SALE_PRICE * RD.QUANTITY + RD.ETC_AMT AS BIGINT)) REMITTANCE_AMT , 0 CNTR_USE_POINT , NULL CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT , NULL ORDER_STATUS_DESC FROM OP_REMITTANCE_DETAIL RD WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%' GROUP BY ORDER_CODE UNION ALL SELECT /* G_CNTR_USE_POINT 조회 */ ORDER_CODE , NULL locgov_code , 0 ORDER_AMT , 0 ORDER_AMT_0 , 0 ORDER_AMT_CANCEL , 0 REMITTANCE_AMT , SUM(CASE WHEN USE_SE_CODE = '1' THEN CAST( CNTR_USE_POINT AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) CNTR_USE_POINT , NULL CREATED_DATE , 0 HOLD_CNT , NULL ORDER_STATUS_DESC FROM G_CNTR_USE_POINT WHERE 1=1 AND ORDER_CODE LIKE 'AB%'
AND ORDER_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
GROUP BY ORDER_CODE ) T_A WHERE 1=1 group by T_A.order_code ) T_B , g_locgov lgov where 1=1 and T_B.locgov_code = lgov.locgov_code
and T_B.match_yn = #{matchYnType}
and T_B.created_date BETWEEN NVL(#{searchStartDate}, CONCAT(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), '0101') || '000000') AND NVL(#{searchEndDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '235959') ) T_C , ( select 1 TP UNION ALL select 2 TP ) T_COPY where 1=1 GROUP BY CASE WHEN T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN T_C.ORDER_CODE ELSE '합계' end ORDER BY CASE WHEN T_COPY.TP = 1 THEN T_C.ORDER_CODE ELSE '합계' end desc
